faqs.question: What is WhatsApp Business API in Singapore, and how can businesses use it?
faqs.answer:
• WhatsApp Business API, also called the WhatsApp Business Platform, helps growing businesses in Singapore communicate with customers without managing every conversation manually. It supports bulk campaigns, AI chatbots, CRM integrations, automated notifications, and customer support with multiple agents.
  • Singapore SMEs and enterprises can use it to manage order updates, appointment reminders, promotional campaigns, and customer enquiries.
  • And you don't need to be a developer to get started. With MSG91, businesses can connect WhatsApp, launch campaigns, create chatbots, and manage customer conversations through a simple, no-code dashboard.

faqs.question: What is the pricing of WhatsApp Business API in Singapore?
faqs.answer:
• WhatsApp Business API pricing in Singapore includes messaging charges and a platform subscription. MSG91 offers messaging rates approximately 10% lower than Meta's standard GBP pricing, helping businesses save on customer communication.
  • MSG91's rates for Singapore numbers (+65), in GBP, are:
    • Marketing: £0.04772 per message
    • Utility: £0.01043 per message
    • Authentication: £0.01043 per message
    • Service: £0.01043 per billable message after the free allowance
  • The MSG91 Titan plan costs £6/month, with the first two months free. Messaging charges and applicable taxes are separate.
  • For example, sending 10,000 billable marketing messages costs £477.20 with MSG91 compared with £528 at Meta's standard rate, saving £50.80 before subscription fees and taxes.
  • Actual savings depend on messaging volume, applicable pricing tiers, and billing arrangements.
  • For a detailed breakdown, explore MSG91 WhatsApp Business API Pricing in Singapore and Meta's WhatsApp Business Platform Pricing.
